name: hkx-typescript-review
description: TypeScript-focused multi-angle review: typescript-reviewer + security + tests + silent failures, then synthesis.

parallel.label: TS idioms
parallel.task:
TypeScript-focused review for:

{task}

Focus: type safety (any leakage, unsafe casts/assertions), generics fit, async patterns (unawaited promises, error propagation), module boundaries and import hygiene, strictness flag compliance, dependency surface, and performance-sensitive paths.
Inspect the actual staged/unstaged diff and related TypeScript files. Cite path:line evidence.
Do not modify project/source files; returning findings via the configured output artifact is allowed.

Return severity-ranked findings, a verdict (approve / request-changes / block), and the smallest safe fixes.

Configured output path is under `.pi-subagents/` (gitignored) and is the only permitted write target for this review. Do not modify project/source files. Do not request supervisor input solely to write that configured review artifact. If a tool or permission layer blocks the write, retry once; parent auto-reply may handle artifact-only authorization.
